widgets.text: Medabots: robots built from four parts (Head, Right arm, Left arm, Legs) plus a Medal. Robattles: knock out the enemy leader's head.
widgets.label: How it plays

widgets.text: Head parts have limited uses; arms attack/heal; legs set movement type.
widgets.label: Parts

widgets.text: Break the enemy leader's head to win. Medal levels unlock Medaforce.
